notes: cells/by_year = MODIS (Terra+Aqua, 1km, from Nov 2000) for 2000-2011 and VIIRS S-NPP (375m, from 2012) for 2012-2024; the two sensors have different sensitivity (VIIRS 375m is more sensitive), so do not compare counts across the 2011/2012 break. cells_modis is the consistent MODIS-only series 2000-2024. Only detection type 0 (presumed vegetation fire); static sources/offshore excluded. Counts are detections (hotspots), not fires or area burned. Country archives end 2024-12-31; 2025-26 need a MAP_KEY (not used).
source: https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/data/country/ (NASA FIRMS, MODIS Collection 6.1 and VIIRS S-NPP 375m standard-quality archive)
